name: ToF Gradient Computation for Gaussian Splatting
aliases: Opacity gradient for ToF image formation
definition: Computation of the gradient of the loss function L with respect to the opacity parameter alpha_k of the k-th Gaussian for Time-of-Flight (ToF) image formation models, specifically for phasor or quad pixel signals.
summary: ToF Gradient Computation for Gaussian Splatting calculates opacity gradients for Time-of-Flight signals by using recursive accumulation with squared transmittance factors, unlike standard linear color rendering.
